scope: command families protocol command families, exact interaction routes and explicit change-only reconciliation over existing API v10 Models/Commands/Interactions.
reviewedContracts: REST/Gateway v10 remain the latest officially available versions; this features changes authoring and existing-model lowering only.
Slash command groups admit exactly group/subcommand nesting, at most 25 siblings, no mixed root primitive options and subcommands; existing validators remain authoritative.
Registration identity is application, scope, command type and name. User/message menu commands may share names across types. Guild registrations reject global-only contexts and entry points.
Autocomplete carries partial supplied arguments, exactly one focused string/integer/number option and at most 25 matching choices; required options may be missing and focused input may be incomplete.

Initial response kinds remain distinct: type 8 for autocomplete, type 9 modal only from commands/components, type 7 update only for components and modal submits originating from a message. Modal submits cannot open another modal.
Context menu targets use target_id and partial resolved objects without implicit hydration or local authorization.

Component and modal custom IDs admit 1...100 Unicode scalars in existing validators. Modal submissions include label-wrapped typed text/select/file/radio/checkbox values; unknown kinds must remain explicit or fail before user execution.

Registration synchronization remains an explicit fresh-list comparison followed by sequential changed managed upserts; no bulk overwrite, unmanaged deletion, automatic startup registration or blind mutation replay.
qualification: Current official-source review and local/offline authoring tests only. Existing upstream model gaps, live Discord registration/rendering, independent audit, other platforms and remaining dsl features are excluded.
